Flight Deck / selected concept 04

Compact updraft geometry audit

The selected design is now an editable vector. Its four sharp tips, two separate shapes, and compact lower curl are preserved.

The source was a 1254 × 1254 PNG. No earlier SVG existed. The mark was reconstructed as cubic Bézier paths, then checked against the source.

Airflow spacing

The gap ranges from 31.80 to 56.76 units. It reaches its broadest point about 33% along the shared channel, then narrows toward the tips. It opens slightly at the exit.

The widths preserve the original design. They were measured across the flow, perpendicular to the bisector of the two local edge tangents, at 854 cross sections. The profile has one interior peak and one interior trough with prominence above 0.3 units.

Composition and small sizes

The mark measures 667.35 × 617.61 units. The full logo preserves a 76.41-unit gap above the wordmark.

The mark's bounding-box center sits 25.74 units right of the wordmark center. That offset comes from the selected composition and remains unchanged in intent. The standalone mark has 48 units of clear space on each side.

32 pixels wide is the smallest tested 1× raster size at which the two shapes remain separate. At 16 and 24 pixels, the thresholded shapes merge.

Sizes refer to the full standalone SVG, including its padding. Raster tests use librsvg, a 50% alpha threshold, and 8-connected pixels. Rendering can vary with pixel alignment and display density.

Files and measurement method

Both SVGs contain vector paths with transparent backgrounds. They contain no embedded raster image, live text, or external font dependency. The wordmark is a traced outline of the generated source, not a verified font master. The detailed curve audit covers the symbol.

The symbol uses cubic splines with constrained endpoints and one-sided endpoint tangents. The interior curves have continuous tangents and curvature. Coordinates are exported to six decimal places. Join checks use those rounded coordinates.

Bounds use the exact extrema of the cubic paths. Contour distances, curvature profiles, and intersection checks use dense curve samples. Those checks report sampled results, not an analytic proof for every point on the curves.

Source coordinates use one unit per pixel of the 1254 × 1254 PNG. Control geometry, measurement data, and the side-by-side comparison accompany the exports.

Rebuild and rerun the checks

From the project root, with the dependencies in requirements.txt installed and rsvg-convert available:

.venv/bin/python output/flight-deck/vector/build_logo.py
.venv/bin/python output/flight-deck/vector/audit_logo.py
.venv/bin/python output/flight-deck/vector/write_report.py

The audit rejects open geometry, component overlaps, mismatched joins, missing vector-only exports, and excessive deviation from the source.

Selected source: 04-compact-updraft.png. This audit preserves the selected concept and records its geometry and raster limits.
